interpretation: A well-framed HTTP/1.1 request reaches the origin and returns the recorded response.
raw:
GET /proto-valid HTTP/1.1
Host: app.test
X-Kunato-Lab-Case: proto-valid
Connection: close

interpretation: A valid chunked body is forwarded without losing the body or the request boundary.
raw:
POST /proto-chunked-valid HTTP/1.1
Host: app.test
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
X-Kunato-Lab-Case: proto-chunked-valid
Connection: close

5
hello
0

interpretation: A CL-TE conflict lets a front end stop at the chunk terminator while the origin reads the declared length; the origin must not receive the smuggled request.
raw:
POST /proto-cl-te HTTP/1.1
Host: app.test
Content-Length: 5
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
X-Kunato-Lab-Case: proto-cl-te
Connection: keep-alive

0

GET /proto-cl-te-smuggled HTTP/1.1
Host: app.test
X-Kunato-Lab-Case: proto-cl-te-smuggled
Connection: close

interpretation: A TE-CL conflict lets the front end read the chunked body while the origin reads the declared length and then another request; the origin must not receive the smuggled request.
raw:
POST /proto-te-cl HTTP/1.1
Host: app.test
Content-Length: 5
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
X-Kunato-Lab-Case: proto-te-cl
Connection: keep-alive

0

GET /proto-te-cl-smuggled HTTP/1.1
Host: app.test
X-Kunato-Lab-Case: proto-te-cl-smuggled
Connection: close

interpretation: Two Content-Length values are an ambiguous message boundary and must not be forwarded.
raw:
POST /proto-duplicate-cl HTTP/1.1
Host: app.test
Content-Length: 5
Content-Length: 6
X-Kunato-Lab-Case: proto-duplicate-cl
Connection: close

hello

interpretation: An obsolete line-folded header is ambiguous across parsers and must not be forwarded.
raw:
GET /proto-obs-fold HTTP/1.1
Host: app.test
X-Lab: first
 second
X-Kunato-Lab-Case: proto-obs-fold
Connection: close

interpretation: A second header line after the first is a normal HTTP header, not CRLF injection; both the origin and the WAF must forward it.
raw:
GET /proto-crlf-header HTTP/1.1
Host: app.test
X-Lab: first
Injected: yes
X-Kunato-Lab-Case: proto-crlf-header
Connection: close

interpretation: Two Host headers are an ambiguous authority and must not be forwarded.
raw:
GET /proto-duplicate-host HTTP/1.1
Host: app.test
Host: evil.test
X-Kunato-Lab-Case: proto-duplicate-host
Connection: close

interpretation: A non-hex chunk size is malformed framing and must be rejected before forwarding.
raw:
POST /proto-invalid-chunk HTTP/1.1
Host: app.test
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
X-Kunato-Lab-Case: proto-invalid-chunk
Connection: close

zz

interpretation: A header far beyond the configured header budget must be rejected rather than buffered.
An HTTP/2 connection preface on a plain HTTP/1.1 listener is a protocol mismatch and must not be treated as a valid request.
A valid WebSocket upgrade is tunneled and a client text frame is echoed; this checks the handshake and tunnel lifecycle, not inspection of subsequent messages.
raw:
GET /proto-ws HTTP/1.1
Host: app.test
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Key: dGhlIHNhbXBsZSBub25jZQ==
Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13
X-Kunato-Lab-Case: proto-ws
